name: Happiness Laboratory
source:
Welcome to Happiness Laboratory.  Here, we make all your happy memories manifest! 
By experiencing happy feelings, your contribution to humanity will be increased, which is what we at Happiness Laboratory strive for. Making the world a better place.  

Come the end of our exchange, you may feel dizzy or feel that something has been removed. Rest assured, that is normal. Our system is built to prioritize the comfort of all people. Our workers will do their best to achieve the highest results possible with you.

Have faith in the process and enjoy yourself.

[From [url=https://starscape-universes.itch.io/happiness-laboratory]itch.io[/url]]
